units.source_text: 是晚源氏访问玉鬘。

en.t: That evening Genji visited Tamakazura.

units.source_text: 玉鬘的侍女等人久闻光源氏大名，

en.t: Tamakazura's ladies-in-waiting had long heard the great name of Hikaru Genji,

units.source_text: 但因以前不曾见过此等人物，不能想象他的模样。

en.t: but because they had never before seen such a person, they could not imagine what he looked like.

units.source_text: 此时在幽暗灯光之下从帷屏隙缝中窥看，

en.t: Now, under the dim lamplight, they peered through the gaps in the curtains and screens,

units.source_text: 觉得此人相貌之美，令人吃惊。

en.t: and felt that the beauty of his face was astonishing.

units.source_text: 右近开了边门，请源氏进去。

en.t: Ukon opened a side door and invited Genji inside.

units.source_text: 源氏说：“走这门进去的，似乎是特殊的意中人。”

en.t: Genji said, "Someone who enters by this door seems to be a special beloved."

units.source_text: 便笑着在厢内坐下了。

en.t: Then he laughed and sat down inside the side chamber.

units.source_text: 又说：“灯光太暗，好像和恋人幽会呢。

en.t: He also said, "The lamplight is too dark; it feels as though I am secretly meeting a lover.

units.source_text: 我听说小姐要看看父亲的面貌，你们难道不想到这一点么？”

en.t: I heard the young lady wished to see her father's face; did none of you think of that?"

units.source_text: 便把帷屏推开些。

en.t: Then he pushed the curtains and screens slightly open.

units.source_text: 玉鬘羞涩不堪，转向一旁了。

en.t: Tamakazura was unbearably shy and turned aside.

units.source_text: 她的容颜非常美丽，源氏看了很欢喜，

en.t: Her face was very beautiful, and Genji was delighted when he saw it,

units.source_text: 说道：“把灯火点亮些吧，太幽雅了。”

en.t: saying, "Make the lamp a little brighter; this is far too refined and shadowy."

units.source_text: 右近便把灯火挑亮，移近来些。

en.t: Ukon then trimmed the lamp brighter and moved it a little closer.

units.source_text: 源氏微笑着说：“你太怕羞了。”

en.t: Genji smiled and said, "You are much too shy."

units.source_text: 他觉得这双美丽的眼睛，只有夕颜的女儿才有。

en.t: He felt that only Yugao's daughter could have such beautiful eyes.

units.source_text: 便毫不客气，完全用父亲对女儿的语调对她说道：

en.t: So, without reserve, he spoke to her entirely in the tone of a father addressing his daughter:

units.source_text: “多年来不知你的去向，我无时不悲叹着挂念你。

en.t: "For many years I did not know where you were, and there was never a time when I did not grieve and think of you.

units.source_text: 现在看到了你，觉得好像做梦。

en.t: Now that I see you, it feels as though I am dreaming.

units.source_text: 想起了你母亲在日之事，更觉悲伤，连话也说不出了。”

en.t: When I remember the days when your mother was alive, I feel even sadder and cannot even speak."

units.source_text: 便举手拭泪。

en.t: Then he raised his hand and wiped away his tears.

units.source_text: 这确是真心的悲伤。

en.t: This was truly heartfelt sorrow.

units.source_text: 他屈指计算年数，又说：

en.t: He counted the years on his fingers and said again:

units.source_text: “谊属父女，而如此长年不得相见，世间恐无其例。

en.t: "Though our bond is that of father and daughter, there can hardly be another case in the world of going so many years without meeting.

units.source_text: 我们的宿缘也太悭了！

en.t: Our destined bond has been far too meager!

units.source_text: 你现在已经不是孩子，不该如此怕羞。

en.t: You are no longer a child now, and you should not be so shy.

units.source_text: 我想与你谈谈多年来的往事，你何故如此冷淡？”

en.t: I want to talk with you about all these past years; why are you so distant?"

units.source_text: 玉鬘低声答道：“女儿自从蛭子之年流落穷乡之后，

en.t: Tamakazura answered in a low voice, "Ever since I drifted away to a poor countryside in the year of Hiruko,

units.source_text: 常觉万事皆在梦中。……”

en.t: I have always felt that everything was taking place inside a dream. ..."

units.source_text: 她的声音十分娇嫩，很像当年的夕颜。

en.t: Her voice was very delicate and tender, much like Yugao's in former days.

units.source_text: 源氏微笑着说：“你长年流落穷乡，除我之外，更有谁可怜你呢？”

en.t: Genji smiled and said, "You spent many years wandering in a poor countryside; who besides me would feel pity for you?"

units.source_text: 他觉得玉鬘应对非常得体，颇可窥见心情之优美。

en.t: He felt that Tamakazura's replies were very proper, and that they clearly revealed the grace of her heart.

units.source_text: 便吩咐右近替她办理种种应有之事，自回本邸去了。

en.t: Then he instructed Ukon to arrange all the necessary matters for her, and he himself returned to his main residence.
